en.answer: While the effect of <<11851>> is being applied, only battle damage or effect damage to a player's Life Points is prevented. A monster that is destroyed by battle is still destroyed normally.
en.question: While the first effect of <<11851>> is being applied, preventing all damage inflicted to the player with fewer Life Points, does it also prevent their monsters from being destroyed by battle?
en.title: While the first effect of <<11851>> is being applied, preventing all damage inflicted to the player with fewer Life Points, does it also prevent their monsters from being destroyed by battle?

ja.answer:
「<<11851>>」の『受ける全てのダメージは０になる』効果が適用されている場合、そのプレイヤーは、戦闘によってプレイヤー自身が受けるダメージ、カードの効果によってプレイヤー自身が受けるダメージが０になるのみです。

モンスターが戦闘で破壊される際には通常通り破壊されます。
